rules.description: Verifies that livestock inventory StatVars have observations within 1 year of the effective release year (accounting for USDA spring release lag) and all other survey StatVars are within 2 years

params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5' MONTH)) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_FarmInventory_(CattleAndCalves|BeefCows|MilkCows|SheepAndLambs)$') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
